Hi everyone!

I'm Tanaeem, a software engineer (distributed systems) new to Lean. As a side project, I've been experimenting with formalizing the time complexity of elementary algorithms (using AI agents).

To establish feasibility, I've defined Stein's binary GCD, proved its equivalence to Nat.gcd, and established logarithmic step bounds connected to Asymptotics.IsBigO for both.

Before going further down this path (sorting, dynamic programming, space complexity), I'd love some guidance from experienced folks:

  • Is there an existing interest or home in the Lean ecosystem for formal algorithm complexity, or is this primarily suited for an independent standalone repo?
  • In Lean 4, is companion step counting the accepted pattern, or do people prefer a different formulation when doing complexity work?
  • Are there common traps when doing asymptotic complexity in Lean that beginners usually run into?

Repo if interested: https://github.com/tanaeem-moosa/amort

Thanks in advance for any pointers or recommended reading!
